source: Harris and Dodson 2004, Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 49, Fig. 4A: panel A, a published sauropod cladogram; slanted, root at the bottom, thin lines, four clade names joined to nodes by thin curved arrows. Tips include the clade names Theropoda and Prosauropoda as outgroups. Panel B (another analysis, with support values) is excluded. Image: census 2 figure (2010x2652 px), a 300 dpi page render of the vector figure.

gold_note: Panel A, read by eye at 3-4x. Dicraeosauridae, Diplodocinae, Diplodocidae and Diplodocoidea, each joined to its node by an arrow, are kept as internal labels. Polytomies: the root (Theropoda and Prosauropoda meet the sauropod line at one point), Haplocanthosaurus-Diplodocoidea-Macronaria (two lines converge into that node), and the four-way titanosaur node (Nemegtosaurus, “Titanosaurus” colberti, Opisthocoelicaudia-Alamosaurus, Neuquensaurus-Saltasaurus). 29 tips, 3 polytomies (3, 3, 4 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 7 case (census 2, seed 20261241). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
